## 中文

- 改善首次使用体验：“文件来源”在首次打开或旧配置地址为空时预填 `https://github.com/ntfargo/Relapse-Exploit`，网页入口默认 `index.html`。地址可编辑，已保存的自定义来源和已下载资源的来源继续保留；下载由用户点击“下载并检查”触发。
- 同步中英文界面提示、README 和详细指南。中英文 README 的七步流程图改为直接显示，无需展开。
- 53 项自动化测试通过；通过模拟 Electron 启动检查验证首次启动、空配置、自定义来源和已下载资源四种状态，以及启动时不会自动下载。

Windows x64 提供安装版与便携版；macOS Intel、Apple Silicon 分别提供 DMG 和 ZIP。所有包未代码签名，macOS 未公证。

预填地址不代表已验证第三方内容的安全性、固件兼容性或实际运行效果。请按上游说明确认兼容性；本项目尚未完成 PS5 实机验证。服务启动或文件发送完成不代表第三方内容已在 PS5 成功运行。

本项目仅供技术交流和合法授权测试，处理用户自行提供或有权使用的内容。构建包不附带网页资源、第三方 ELF 或游戏内容；第三方资源由用户主动下载并遵守其许可。软件按现状提供，不保证效果，使用者承担自身操作责任；相关权利归第三方所有。完整边界与免责声明见 README。

## English

- Improve first-use setup: “File source” is prefilled with `https://github.com/ntfargo/Relapse-Exploit` on first launch or when the saved URL is empty. The default entry file is `index.html`. The URL remains editable; saved custom sources and the source of downloaded content are retained. Downloads start only when the user clicks “Download and verify.”
- Update Chinese and English interface text, README files and detailed guides. Both README files now show the seven-step diagram directly, without expanding a section.
- All 53 automated tests pass. Simulated Electron startup checks cover first launch, an empty saved URL, a custom source and downloaded content, and verify that startup does not trigger a download.

Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages; macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages. All builds are unsigned; macOS builds are not notarized.

Prefilling a URL does not verify third-party content safety, firmware compatibility or execution results. Check compatibility against upstream instructions; PS5 hardware testing remains outstanding. Service startup or completed file delivery does not confirm successful execution on PS5.

For technical exchange and authorized testing of user-provided or authorized content. Builds do not bundle web resources, third-party ELFs or game content. Third-party downloads require user action and remain subject to their licenses. The software is provided as-is without guaranteed results; users are responsible for their actions, and third-party rights remain with their owners. See the README for the full usage boundaries and disclaimer.
